answer: Use bonded work seats with randomized audits. 1) Each new key locks 72 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 72,000 POA, risks 36,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like saffron carried from a haven along a ridge, one verified worker leaves one path; aliases cannot widen it.
